item.title: April Fools | Pitt will lease old Panther Pit building for new first-year dorms - The Pitt News
item.description: Pitt confirmed widespread rumors of new, non-traditional dorm buildings for the next academic year. The university will lease the building that formerly housed Panther Pit, turning it into first-year housing. There are also unconfirmed reports of Pitt using a former Burger King storefront in South Side as another new housing location.
